info.name: Audit Catalogue
info.description:
Audit logs for registry changes. Every action on a source record is stored as one immutable log via POST /audit/v1/create; a single catalogue serves all registries.

Run the Lifecycle folder top to bottom for a full demo (each request logs one action). Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8080) and api_key if a gateway needs it.

before/after are JSON strings that the client parses; they are indexed in Elasticsearch, so search returns them directly. Sort a timeline by createdOn on the client.

request.description: Check the service is running before starting.

item.name: Lifecycle
item.description: One request per action in the maker-checker flow. Run top to bottom.

request.description: Maker saves a partial entry. Logs a DRAFT row; before is empty.
Maker completes the entry and submits. Logs a PENDING row; before/after show the fields added.
Supervisor approves the pending change. Logs an APPROVED row.
Registry admin publishes; the record goes live. Logs an ACTIVE row.
Supervisor returns a change for rework. Logs a REWORK row; the maker will fix and resubmit.
Supervisor rejects a change (terminal). Logs a REJECTED row.
An edit to a live record. Logs a row with the field change (maturityDays 140 to 135); status stays ACTIVE.
Registry admin temporarily hides a live record. Logs an INACTIVE row.
Registry admin makes the record visible again. Logs an ACTIVE row.
Registry admin soft-deletes the record. Logs a DELETED row.
